Canonical promotion pipeline consolidation complete. Changes are in commit ef00ec7a on task/MPOS-P1-GOV-001. Summary of changes: (1) Added CANARY to PromotionState enum in gate.py. (2) validate_transition now enforces paper->canary->live; paper->live skip is forbidden, aligning with deployment_plan.py StagePlanner which already forbids that skip. (3) _LIFECYCLE_TO_DEPLOYMENT_STAGE: added canary->canary, fixed retired->none (was incorrectly mapping artifact lifecycle state 'retired' to deployment stage 'frozen'). (4) _LIFECYCLE_TO_ARTIFACT_STATE: added canary->approved. (5) check_requirements: added canary block requiring eval_summary, sharpe_ratio, approver, lineage, and rollback. (6) build_execution_projection: canary and live both require explicit rollback metadata. (7) Tests updated: paper->live skip test added, canary path through paper->canary->live tested. All 121 tests pass. deployment_plan.py _legacy_promotion_state intentionally NOT changed for canary per existing test_canary_projection_keeps_deployment_stage_without_legacy_alias.
Review approved. Gate correctly enforces paper->canary->live canonical path per PAPER_CANARY_LIVE_POLICY. All 121 tests pass. Owner (Claude) may proceed to closeout.
